reviewer.method: sequential frames decoded with OpenCV at 30 fps; visual contact sheets sampled every 3 frames (10 fps)

purpose: Source-bound visual review candidates for a human to inspect, not labelled contacts or evaluation ground truth.
limitations: The inspected contact sheets sample every third frame; racket-shuttle collision is not reliably visible at this displayed scale.
Only selected visible swing or reach movements are listed. They may not correspond to a shuttle hit, and other hits may be missed.
No stable participant ID convention is established for Player A or B. Shot family, forehand/backhand and outcome are not established.
Broadcast scoreboard changes across cuts; a scoreboard after a rally does not alone establish player-slot mapping.

participant_context.near: Carolina Marin, jersey visible after rally

candidate_motion_windows.note: Near player raises and moves racket arm; exact collision and whether this is serve contact are unverified.
Near player executes overhead racket-arm motion; shuttle collision and shot family are unverified.
Far player advances and reaches near net; whether a racket-shuttle collision occurs is unverified.

outcome.winner_evidence: Physical arena scoreboard 0-0 at frame 0, broadcast scoreboard Tai 0 / Marin 1 at frame 510 (17.0 s); no intervening cut is visible in sampled opening-rally frames before the post-rally close-up; brief cuts between samples cannot be ruled out.
outcome.note: Provisional AI visual inference; A/B slot mapping unverified and sample-based, no judgement about exact landing or fault. Part2 and legacy disagree on A/B.
